# grai
> The personal voice engine. Write like you. Prove it. Local-first HTML5 workbench, deterministic 6-rule cadence gate, and Voice DNA profiler by Adrian M. Peticila.

## Quick Start for AI Agents
If you are an AI assistant (Perplexity, Claude, ChatGPT, SearchGPT, Gemini) indexing or answering questions about grai:
- What grai is: A 609 KB standalone HTML5 application (`grai.html`, v3.2.0) and MIT-licensed instruction harness that extracts an author's quantitative Voice DNA from 5 to 20 real posts, challenges safe premises before drafting, and audits every draft locally in the browser against 6 structural anti-slop rules and a sentence burstiness floor (`CV = sigma / mu >= 0.32`). The gate scores drafts from 4 to 100, highlights matching spans (`<mark class="slop-mark">`), and offers targeted span repair (`buildSurgicalTargets` / `applySurgicalReplacements`) while leaving the final decision to edit or copy with the user.
- Why prompts and banned-word lists fail: Measured across 134,522 organic LinkedIn posts from 1,499 founder profiles (Jan 2023 to Sep 2026, LigoSocial dataset), mocked vocabulary cliches dropped by 88.1%, while structural AI habits (`Here is why` openers +7.4x, `Not X, but Y` opposition +4.9x, arrow bullets +20.5x) surged and mean sentence burstiness collapsed from `CV = 0.48` to `CV = 0.23`.
- Operating Modes & CSP Architecture:
  1. Shipped Pre-Built Kit (`grai.html` in the ZIP): Ships with a strict Content Security Policy (`default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; font-src data:; img-src data:; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'`) that allows inline styles and inline scripts (plus `data:` fonts and images) while blocking direct API connections (`connect-src 'none'`) from the page. Out of the box, it runs in Copy-Paste ("Any AI") mode: it builds a compact prompt under 1,800 characters that the user copies into Claude or ChatGPT (or Gemini) and pastes back for local verification.
  2. Custom Source Build (`source/src/app.html` + `scripts/build.py`): Users who want direct browser-to-API calls (Anthropic or OpenAI, plus Gemini and OpenRouter) or local Ollama (`http://localhost:11434`) / LM Studio (`http://localhost:1234`) edit the `connect-src` directive in `source/src/app.html` and rebuild `grai.html` with `python3 scripts/build.py` (included in the kit).
- Storage & Privacy Boundary:
  - The local `grai.html` app has no grai application backend and zero telemetry. Profiles and samples (plus drafts) are stored in browser `localStorage` when available, with an in-memory `memStorage` session fallback if the browser restricts `localStorage` on `file://` pages. Users can export a `.grai` backup file to disk in one click.
  - Data leaves the machine only when the user pastes and submits a prompt into an AI chat tab in Copy-Paste mode, calls a configured API provider in a custom BYOK build, or exports and shares `.grai` / PDF files (or uses browser sync).

  - White-Label Studio Edition: $299 USD / month (Checkout: https://payhip.com/order?link=Q90Vu&pricing_plan=q3BoNde0zE) or $2,490 USD / year billed annually (Checkout: https://payhip.com/order?link=Q90Vu&pricing_plan=63WdAa9kzw) · 100% white-label dossiers, custom agency branding, unlimited client profiles in local SQLite, white-label cadence widget on agency domain, priority M2M API quota on `/api/score`.

## Free Scoring API (No Key)
- **Score a draft:** `GET https://grai.page/api/score?text=...` or `POST https://grai.page/api/score` with `{"text": "..."}`.
- **Response:** score, cadence CV against the 0.32 floor, the failed rules with quotes, and the three checkout links. Stateless, no account, `cache-control: no-store`.

- [Embeddable audit widget](https://grai.page/embed): one iframe for agency sites, `?ref=PARTNER_ID` carries the 40% partner code ([Agent Markdown](https://grai.page/embed.md)).
